Measured_fact: All 24 libraries are retained. Unique alignment is 87.4–88.8%; the mean between-group / within-group distance in the first two principal components is 33.2. These checks support the expression analysis; they do not independently authenticate sample identity.
Interpretation_boundary: None; no identity assay was performed.

Measured_fact: Crtc2 messenger RNA (mRNA) is lower in the Crtc2 line in all four conditions (log2 fold changes -0.58, -0.93, -0.60, -0.59). The transcript remains detectable; protein loss and the nature of the modification are unresolved.
Interpretation_boundary: Protein and functional effects require independent confirmation.

Measured_fact: The untreated lines differ in 1,151 genes. Lower inflammatory/interferon signatures and higher cell-cycle signatures are associated with the Crtc2 line; these are expression associations rather than a demonstrated mechanism.
Interpretation_boundary: An association with line identity; not proof of direct CRTC2 regulation.

Measured_fact: The largest line difference is under tumor necrosis factor (TNF): 5,906 genes. Inflammatory and interferon signatures are lower in the Crtc2 line under TNF. This comparison does not establish a difference in treatment responsiveness.
Interpretation_boundary: A line-by-treatment interaction was not tested.

Measured_fact: In control cells, prostaglandin E2 (PGE2) changes 2,175 genes and adenosine changes 254. Both show inflammatory/interferon enrichment and lower cell-cycle signatures; fewer adenosine genes cross the chosen gene-level threshold.
Interpretation_boundary: Pathway enrichment does not measure pathway activity or establish equivalent effect sizes.

Measured_fact: Confirm CRTC2 protein abundance and selected transcript changes in independent cultures. A formal line-by-treatment interaction analysis would address whether the two lines respond differently to treatment.
Interpretation_boundary: These are proposed follow-up tests, not completed validation.
